name: Upgrade Planner
description: Plans dependency upgrades in safe batches, majors one at a time.
about: Finds what is outdated or vulnerable across npm, Python, Cargo, Go and Bundler using each ecosystem's own tooling. You get an ordered plan: one safe patch-and-minor batch, then each major with the code it would break and how to verify it. It applies a batch only when you ask.
features: Find outdated and vulnerable packages per ecosystem
Flag major bumps that touch code you actually use
Apply one batch at a time and run your tests
examplePrompt: Audit my dependencies and give me an upgrade plan, safest first. Don't change anything yet.
